flynncompanies-flynncompanies:lever:de7a.description: At Flynn, it's not just a job, it's a career Flynn Group of Companies is currently looking to fill a Brake Press Operators position for our day shift. Perform routine maintenance and troubleshoot when issues arise. Ensure productivity and on-time completion of work orders. Assist team in other productions requirements as needed. Qualifications: Experience programing basic equipment. Experience operating CNC machines. Experience operating an Accupress is considered an asset. Able to work with a variety of saws, punch press, shears, folders & various other pneumatic equipment. Ability to read a Tape Measure to 1/16th " or 1 mm. Ability to confidently read and interpret shop drawings/blueprints. Ability to focus on agreed-upon priorities, pay attention to detail that ensures high levels of quality. Mechanically inclined, with knowledge & experience of equipment, tool selection, optimum settings, understanding of how things work and why. Ability to troubleshoot and attend to issues as they arise. Shows interest and willingly strive to learn new skills, and take on new assignments as the workload dictates. What We Offer: Training Available Paid Weekly - Direct Deposit Located on a Bus Route (Day shift only) Overtime available as needed $100 Safety boot allowance after 1 year Full-time hours Unlimited Coffee and Tea

Across our family of brands, we support nonprofits, trade associations, and mission-driven organizations with innovative software, impactful marketing strategies, and tools that empower positive change. Here’s why you’ll love working with us: - Stability & Growth: We’re 100% self-funded, with no outside investors or debt, meaning long-term stability and thoughtful growth. - People-First Culture: Our 95%+ employee retention rate reflects our commitment to competitive pay, respect, and career development. - Global Collaboration: Work with talented team members in the US and the Philippines who share your drive for excellence and impact. - Mission-Focused Work: Every role here supports organizations making the world a better place. Watch Our "Meet the Team" Video https://vimeo.com/1059846216/d84c59a1e7?share=copy ROLE We're seeking a talented and detail-oriented Graphic Designer to support Nexus Marketing's growing roster of client engagements. This is a production-focused role responsible for delivering a high volume of polished design and video work across a variety of formats — social graphics, blog and web visuals, sales and marketing collateral, presentations, and short-form video. jobgether-jobgether:lever:66424d9e-b59d-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Social Media Content Creator based in Australia. This is an exciting opportunity for a creative social media professional to help bring distinctive travel experiences to life online. You’ll create engaging, visually compelling content designed to inspire travellers to discover unique destinations. The role combines hands-on content creation, storytelling, scheduling, and performance analysis across social platforms. You’ll have the opportunity to shape how an established boutique travel offering connects with its audience. A strong focus will be placed on short-form video, particularly reels, alongside accurate and compelling destination storytelling. The ideal environment is flexible, remote, and suited to someone who can work independently while maintaining a high level of attention to detail. As the role develops, there may also be opportunities to contribute to broader digital marketing initiatives. Create and schedule 3–4 social media posts per day , with a strong emphasis on engaging reels and short-form content. Write compelling captions and storytelling copy that brings destinations, experiences, and travel opportunities to life. Follow and implement the monthly content calendar while maintaining the appropriate brand voice, objectives, and publishing cadence. Develop content that resonates particularly well with mature travellers seeking quality, confidence, and distinctive travel experiences. Review social media performance and identify top-performing posts, providing insights that can inform boosting and promotional decisions. Ensure all published content is accurate and reliable, with particular attention to destination names, locations, and geographic references. As the role evolves, potentially contribute to competitor research, website content updates, newsletters, and retargeting initiatives. Requirements: Proven experience in social media management or content creation , ideally within travel, tourism, lifestyle, or a related sector. Demonstrated ability to create engaging reels and short-form video content , including the effective use of text overlays. Strong copywriting and storytelling skills, with the ability to turn travel experiences and destinations into compelling social content. Good understanding of social media analytics, performance tracking, and using insights to improve future content. Excellent attention to detail, particularly when communicating information about destinations, locations, and travel experiences. Understanding of travel audiences, ideally including 50+ consumers who value high-quality and tailor-made experiences. Strong visual instincts and an appreciation for content that is both inspiring and aligned with a clear brand identity. Ability to work independently, manage a content schedule, and consistently deliver work in a fully remote environment. Availability to work approximately 5–10 hours per week , aligned with Sydney, Australia (AEST) hours. Benefits: Fully remote and flexible working arrangement. Part-time commitment of approximately 5–10 hours per week . Opportunity to work with a boutique travel business focused on unique, tailor-made, and off-the-beaten-track experiences. Creative ownership over social media content and storytelling. Opportunity to help shape digital engagement with an established travel audience. Potential to expand your responsibilities into broader areas of digital marketing as the role grows. Work schedule aligned with Sydney/Australian Eastern Standard Time . jobgether-jobgether:lever:86d12e8a-57f1-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Influencer Marketing Account Manager based in Spain. This role offers the opportunity to manage international influencer marketing campaigns from planning through execution and performance analysis. You will serve as a key point of contact for creators while ensuring campaigns remain organized, on-brand, and aligned with client objectives. The position combines account management, creator relations, content quality control, campaign operations, and data analysis. You will work across multiple campaigns and markets, identifying opportunities to improve performance and build stronger creator partnerships. Your attention to detail will be essential when reviewing content, tracking deliverables, and maintaining accurate campaign information. The role is well suited to an organized, analytical professional who enjoys working with influencers, data, and fast-moving digital marketing campaigns. You will also have the opportunity to discover high-performing creators and contribute to the growth of international influencer programs. Manage day-to-day communication and relationships with international influencers and content creators. Coordinate influencer marketing campaigns from initial planning through execution, publication, and performance reporting. Review and approve creator content before publication, ensuring compliance with campaign guidelines, brand requirements, and quality standards. Monitor key campaign metrics including engagement, clicks, conversions, promotional codes, and overall performance. Maintain accurate and up-to-date campaign information across Monday.com, Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Sheets, and similar tools. Identify high-performing influencers and analyze campaign results to uncover opportunities for optimization and future collaborations. Research, approach, evaluate, and recruit new creators who align with client objectives, audiences, and campaign requirements. Track campaign deliverables, deadlines, creator commitments, and other operational requirements. Prepare performance reports and provide ongoing updates on campaign progress and results. Identify content errors, inconsistencies, or process gaps and take appropriate action to maintain campaign quality. Manage multiple campaigns and priorities simultaneously while maintaining strong organization and attention to detail. Professional or advanced English proficiency, both written and conversational. Experience using project management, CRM, or campaign management platforms such as Monday.com, Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Sheets, or comparable tools. Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail. Ability to identify errors, inconsistencies, and potential issues in content, campaign tracking, and operational processes. Excellent communication and relationship-management skills when working with influencers, clients, and internal stakeholders. Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment. Ability to align professional social media profiles with client projects when necessary. Reliable internet connection and an appropriate home working environment.
